Maria S.: Heads-up from compliance: they want a packaged KMS audit bundle covering AWS/GCP/Azure for our envelope encryption + rotation history. 12-month window. Need a defensible minimal set and a README. Can we scope by EOD?

Sam P.: Yes. Minimal bundle I propose:
- Raw audit events: CloudTrail (AWS), Cloud Audit Logs (GCP), KeyVault diagnostics + Activity logs (Azure).
- Key metadata snapshots: ARNs/resourceNames, creation dates, rotation flag, current version IDs.
- Policy/RBAC snapshots: key policies, IAM role bindings, and any SetIamPolicy/PutRolePolicy events.
- Correlation map: link KMS events to data operations (S3/GCS/DB) where datakey use is evident.
- Manifest + checksums (sha256) and short README describing mappings.

Lee C.: For AWS I'll include:
- S3 prefixes with CloudTrail delivery: list objects for the 12mo prefix(s) and include the full s3:// paths.
- A compact CSV of relevant events (eventTime,eventName,userIdentity,requestParameters.resources) filtered for: GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Encrypt, Decrypt, ReEncrypt, CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, EnableKeyRotation, DisableKeyRotation, PutKeyPolicy.
- Athena query example to pull from CloudTrail bucket: 
  SELECT eventtime, eventname, useridentity, resources FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventname IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt') AND year = '2025'

Sam P.: GCP notes:
- If audit logs are exported to BigQuery, export a view containing protoPayload.methodName, resourceName, timestamp, authenticationInfo.principalEmail.
- gcloud example to pull Decrypt events if not exported: 
  gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("Decrypt" OR "Encrypt") AND resource.type="kms_crypto_key"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=500
- Capture cryptoKeyVersion ids for rotation evidence (CreateCryptoKeyVersion, DestroyCryptoKeyVersion).

Anya: Audit requires an evidence README listing: time range, inventory of files (paths or export IDs), how we generated them (commands), and the mapping to each requirement (e.g., where to find rotation events). Also note whether logs are truncated/anonymized.

Lee C.: Azure checklist:
- Confirm each Key Vault has diagnostic settings enabled and where they steam to (Storage/LogAnalytics/EventHub).
- Export KeyVaultAuditEvents for the 12-month window using a Kusto query: 
  KeyVaultAuditingEvents | where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2025-03-01) and OperationName in ("Encrypt","Decrypt","WrapKey","UnwrapKey","Create","Update") | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Identity, CallerIpAddress, Resource
- Include the diagnostic setting resource JSON and retentionDays setting.

Maria S.: Important: manifest must include hashes for each exported file and the S3/GCS URLs or Log-Analytics query IDs. Auditors want a chain: who initiated rotations (user/email), PR/ticket reference for manual rotations, or rotation schedule for automatic rotation.

Sam P.: A few caveats to document:
- CloudTrail records calls but never contains plaintext datakey; confirm app logs don't print keys.
- GCP audit logs show full resourceName including project/location/keyRing/cryptoKey; include that string.
- Azure may only retain detailed KeyVault logs if diagnostic settings were on; if not, note gaps and remediation plan.

Lee C.: Quick commands I'll run and attach results to SEC-2345:
- AWS: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-cloudtrail-prod/AWSLogs/123456789012/CloudTrail/ --recursive --human-readable --summarize --start-after 2025-03-01
- AWS CW Insights for CloudTrail logs: 
  fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters | filter eventName in ['GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt'] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 500
- GCP: gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --project=redwood-prod --limit 500 --format=json > gcp_kms_decrypt_2025.json
- Azure: run Kusto query and export CSV from Log Analytics workspace.

Anya: Also include evidence of RBAC changes: PutRolePolicy/AttachRolePolicy in AWS, SetIamPolicy in GCP, and RoleAssignment changes in Azure. Those need to be correlated to user emails and approval tickets.

Maria S.: Good. For EOD deliverables: file manifest (CSV), checksums, one-paragraph README, CSV/JSON exports of the top N events per cloud, policy snapshots, and the rotation correlation doc (simple table mapping events to PRs/tickets). If you hit permission errors, escalate to infra-ops.

AuditBot: [automated] SEC-2345 created and assigned (Lee C., Sam P.). Deadline 2026-03-20.

Lee C.: I'll drop S3 object list + sample CloudWatch Insights CSV in the ticket when done; will note any missing diagnostic settings. :thumbsup:

Maria S.: Thanks all. If auditors want hashes signed, we'll need to provision an export pipeline that computes sha256 and stores manifests; Anya will confirm whether unsigned hashes suffice for now.

Anya: I'll check with auditor on signature requirement and post back here.
